backlog.ask: AI TUTOR AGENT (side project, operator-parked op#13629): an agent that builds interactive lessons at the learner's own pace. Three phases from the Eero Alvar approach the operator sent: PROBE (quiz to map what they actually know, not what the syllabus assumes) -> PLAN (structured path, rendered as a Mermaid graph, fact-checked by sub-agents) -> TEACH (small digestible steps with periodic quizzes), plus a persistent log so the learner's state survives sessions.
backlog.note: PARKED BY THE OPERATOR — 'side project (park this)'. NOT a build assignment; do not start one. TWO THINGS WORTH KEEPING so future-us does not relearn them: (1) THE INTERESTING HALF IS THE PROBE, not the tutoring. Models already tutor well; what nobody ships is an accurate, continuously-updated model of what the learner already knows -- that is what makes plan and teach worth anything. (2) It is the SAME THREE-ROLE SHAPE as the substrate's planner/builder/auditor (lane_tasks acceptance, 048) and the assigned-audit mechanism (049/050): something plans, something does, something checks. Different domain, same skeleton -- so if it thaws, steal the shape rather than reinvent it.
backlog.done_when: Not applicable while parked. If it thaws: DONE means a learner completed one lesson whose plan came from a probe of their ACTUAL prior knowledge, and the probe was re-run and changed the plan at least once. Anything less is a chatbot with a syllabus.
